description: This file contains the internal implementation of the OrleansSiloInstanceManager class for managing silo instances in Azure Storage tables within an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, activating, querying, and cleaning up silo entries, as well as for managing table entries conditionally. The class uses Azure Data Tables SDK and interacts with external components like AzureTableDataManager, and logging facilities.

classes.name: OrleansSiloInstanceManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing silo instances within an Azure storage table for an Orleans cluster, providing methods for silo registration, activation, retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: GetManager
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and returns an instance of OrleansSiloInstanceManager, ensuring the storage table is initialized.

methods.name: CreateTableVersionEntry
methods.description: Creates a new table entry representing a version of the silo table.

methods.name: RegisterSiloInstance
methods.description: Registers a silo instance into the storage table, setting its status to 'Created'.

methods.name: UnregisterSiloInstance
methods.description: Marks a silo instance as 'Dead' in the storage table.

methods.name: ActivateSiloInstance
methods.description: Marks a silo instance as 'Active' in the storage table.

methods.name: ConvertToGatewayUri
methods.description: Converts a silo instance entry into a gateway URI object.

methods.name: FindAllGatewayProxyEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves all active gateway proxy endpoints as URIs.

methods.name: DumpSiloInstanceTable
methods.description: Generates a string dump of all silo entries for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: MergeTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Merges a silo entry into the storage table asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single silo table entry based on partition and row keys.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries for a given cluster id.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries that are not active and are older than a specified date.

methods.name: DeleteEntriesBatch
methods.description: Deletes a batch of silo entries.

methods.name: FindSiloEntryAndTableVersionRow
methods.description: Finds silo entry and version row for the given silo address.

methods.name: FindAllSiloEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all silo entries for the deployment.

methods.name: TryCreateTableVersionEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a table version entry if it does not exist.

methods.name: InsertSiloEntryConditionally
methods.description: Inserts a silo entry conditionally based on the version row etag.

methods.name: UpdateSiloEntryConditionally
methods.description: Updates a silo entry conditionally based on the etag.
